## Approved operating design (planned; not verified as implemented)

- **Go Live**: broadcaster chooses one of the 17 General Live categories, sets stream title and permissions, and broadcasts to viewers.
- **Group Rooms**: participant chooses an existing women's, men's, coed, dating, sports, music/talent or news topic; host starts a **video, voice, or text** session.
- **Chat**: text chat available during video and voice; members can listen, message, react, raise hand and request to speak.
- **Host tools**: speaker approval, optional open microphones, co-hosts, mute, moderation, remove, block/report, and Leave Room.
- **Room activity**: viewers/listeners, likes, reactions, online/participant counts.
- **Donations**: configurable daily goals, shareable goal links, messages, sound/vibration alerts, pinned donation acknowledgements (2 minutes to 2 hours), Donation Inbox, Thank Supporter, and appreciation guidelines.
- **Additional Live plans**: PIKK Broadcast multistream to PIKK Live, YouTube Live, Twitch, Kick, TikTok LIVE, Instagram Live, Facebook Live; Gift Battles; separate livestream-only Roast Battles; 24/7 Viral Live; subscriber alerts; replays; private sessions; rights, safety and moderation protections.

**Implementation note:** The current directory is category/channel discovery, not verified hosted group video/voice/text infrastructure. Payments, multistream, alerts and broadcast systems are also not verified complete.
